title: SPL mint authority
detects: A non-null pubkey can mint unlimited new supply. Null means the authority was permanently revoked.
knownFalseNegative: An active mint authority is NOT inherently a risk, and treating it as one is the single most common scoring error. Stablecoin issuers must mint against reserves, and liquid staking tokens must mint on deposit. Verified on 2026-07-22: USDC, USDT, ORCA, JitoSOL and mSOL all carry an active mint authority and are all legitimate. Always resolve the registry before scoring this.

coversExamples.observed: ACTIVE, expected for a regulated issuer
ACTIVE, structurally required, the token mints on SOL deposit

rationale: The headline Solana capability, and the one most often misread. The pattern reads it. The registry decides whether it is expected.
